params.name: arg1

params.description: The quartile value to return: 1st quartile = 1; median value = 2; 3rd quartile = 3.
params.name: arg2

signature: QUARTILE_EXC(arg1: ApiRange | ApiName | number[], arg2: ApiRange | ApiName | number): number
